tools.name: query_top_usa_names
tools.description: Execute a live BigQuery SQL query against bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_current strictly using the signed-in human user's 3LO Google OAuth 2.0 credential (On-Behalf-Of passthrough), returning top baby names by US state alongside cryptographic BigQuery SESSION_USER() and job.user_email proof.

state.description: Two-letter US state postal code (e.g., CA, NY, TX, WA, FL). Defaults to CA.

start_year.description: Minimum birth year inclusive (1910-2025). Defaults to 2015.

gender.description: Optional gender filter: 'F' or 'M'. Omit to include all.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (1-20). Defaults to 5.

annotations.title: Query Top USA Baby Names (User OBO)

tools.name: verify_obo_credential_evidence
tools.description: Prove end-user credential passthrough (Pattern 2) with two live BigQuery checks: (1) confirm the Cloud Run runtime service account has ZERO BigQuery permissions (HTTP 403 Access Denied on ADC), and (2) run SELECT SESSION_USER() using the end user's OAuth 2.0 token, returning SESSION_USER(), BigQuery job_id, job.user_email, and Cloud Audit Log filter.

tools.name: get_authenticated_caller
tools.description: Inspect the verified Google OAuth 2.0 caller claims, scopes, Apigee X gateway-attested headers, and zero-privilege Cloud Run service account identity without running a BigQuery job.

annotations.title: Get OBO Caller & Apigee Gateway Context
